```{r loading dataset}

read the file

cat("Excel file loaded successfully")

```


```{r rename the cols}



clean_names <- function(name) {
  
  # Special handling for "Please indicate how often..." format
  if (grepl("please indicate how often you have experienced the following over the last three months:", tolower(name))) {
    name <- sub(".*- ", "", name)
  }
  
  # Then apply standard cleaning
  name %>%
    tolower() %>%
    gsub("please ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("what is your ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("how often have you felt ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("how often ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("do you feel that ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("please describe ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("please state ", "", .) %>%
    gsub("\\?", "", .) %>%
    gsub(":", "", .) %>%
    gsub(" in years", "", .) %>%
    gsub(" over the last three months", "", .) %>%
    # Additional cleaning for specific columns
    gsub("your coping mechanisms for stress", "coping_mechanisms", .) %>%
    gsub("you are getting enough support from your university", "university_support", .) %>%
    gsub("your coping mechanisms help to manage or relieve stress successfully", "effective_scale", .) %>%
    gsub("you felt stressed over the last three months", "felt_stress", .)
    # Final standardization
    gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", .) %>%
    gsub("^_+|_+$", "", .) %>%
    gsub("_+", "_", .)
}
# Apply cleaning
original_names <- colnames(uk_student_data)
colnames(uk_student_data) <- sapply(original_names, clean_names)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("COLUMN NAME MAPPINGS\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Showing all column transformations:\n\n")

# Create a nice table format
mapping_df <- data.frame(
  Original = original_names,
  Cleaned = colnames(uk_student_data),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Print with better formatting
for (i in 1:nrow(mapping_df)) {
  cat(sprintf("%2d. %-70s → %s\n", 
              i, 
              substr(mapping_df$Original[i], 1, 70),  # Truncate if too long
              mapping_df$Cleaned[i]))
}
